task.title: Creating the Haystack tagsImportFile and equipImportFile
task.shortdesc: The Haystack dictionary uses JSON import structures, which serve the same functional purpose as the legacy tagsImportFile and equipImportFile, but with improved validation, clarity, and forward compatibility.

li.p: You have an open station connection (local or remote)
The Haystack tag dictionary is installed in the station.

step.cmd: In the NavTree navigate to the station’s TagDictionaryService, right-click on the Haystack dictionary and click ActionsMake Import Files.

In the Make Import Files window, click on the Browse icon to open a Directory Chooser window, navigate to the desired location, select the folder where you want the JSON import files to be saved, and click Choose. In the Make Import Files window, click OK.
step.info:
generates two JSON files in the selected folder:
tagsImport.json
equipImport.json
These files contain editable copies of the Haystack dictionary's tag definitions, tag groups, relations, and rule elements.Optionally, if you invoke the action from the WB haystack palette with the local station closed, the Directory Chooser opens on the local PC file system.
